item.title: Alcaraz becomes youngest man to complete career Grand Slam
item.description: CARLOS ALCARAZ beat Novak Djokovic to win his first Australian Open title on Sunday, becoming the youngest man to complete a career Grand Slam. The win denied Djokovic a 25th Grand Slam title.Alcaraz recovered after losing the opening set to defeat the 38-year-old 2-6, 6-2, 6-3, 7-5 on Rod Laver Arena.
